observations: The page number «XIX» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01-L02 end Suter's discussion of Robert of Chester's adiectiones begun on p. XVIII (JP2 0022, L21-L37); the minutes and seconds of arc are printed with the single and double prime.

L06-L14: the table of N, between a double rule above and a double rule below its head, with single vertical rules between the columns: «collecti» over the years, «medio die Cordubae» (at noon at Cordova) over the signs, degrees, minutes and seconds of the mean motion of the node; each row is one line here, its cells separated by our «|». L09: «50 ?», the question mark printed in the table.

Checked: from row to row the values grow by 6 signs 23° 27′ 42″ or 43″ (the mean motion of the node in thirty Arab years), in every step but those before and after 420; with that step the seconds of 420 would be 6, not 50, and 450 follows from 6 as from the other rows. Suter's question mark stands at this value.

L16-L17: thirty figures, for the thirty single years of table 20. L23: «(od. una)», «or una», Suter's alternative reading, the parenthesis and «od.» in roman type. L24: «(?)», upright, after a thin space.
Marks not transcribed: the outline of a spacing sort, printed lightly as a bracket, between «Medialitas» and «draconis» (L05).
copy_matter: A vertical stroke of pencil, about 300 px long, in the right margin beside L37-L38. Not part of the edition.
